# hallpass_oidc_group_mapping (Resource)

Maps a group from the provider's groups claim to an operator role, or to an operator group (for approver rules). Operators get it at their next sign-in. Import with `<provider_id>/<mapping_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hallpass_oidc_group_mapping" "admins" {
  provider_id = hallpass_oidc_provider.entra.id
  group_value = "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
  role        = "administrator"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_value` (String) Group value as it appears in the claim. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `provider_id` (String) OIDC provider ID (`oidc_…`). Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `group_id` (String) Operator group ID (`grp_…`). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `role` (String) Operator role: `administrator`, `approver`, `auditor` or `viewer`. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Mapping ID (`ogm_…`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <provider_id>/<mapping_id>
terraform import hallpass_oidc_group_mapping.admins oidc_01m5qh1t09e4jbmeys0q0bjz8j/ogm_01m5qh1t09e4jbmeys0q0bjz8k
```
